engine_internal_values_observed.pcie_probe_and_flag_are_disjoint: joining probe lines to launch vectors per launch: 42 launches logged a probe and passed no --pcie-frac, 15 passed --pcie-frac and logged no probe line, 0 did both, 0 did neither (42 + 15 = 57). The engine probes the link only when the flag is absent, so the probe census and the override census describe complementary populations
engine_internal_values_observed.pcie_probe_reported_bandwidth: 42 of the 57 launches logged a PCIe probe line. The best-of-four value ranges 11.0-11.6 GB/s host->device across launches (11.0 x1, 11.1 x1, 11.2 x1, 11.4 x14, 11.5 x20, 11.6 x5); 11.5 is the modal value, not a property of the machine
engine_internal_values_observed.conversation_cache_off_launches: 7 launches logged 'conversation cache off: not enough free RAM to park conversations'; 27 logged a sized budget; 23 logged neither line (57 total). The cause of the 23 is U and is not analysed here
engine_internal_values_observed.cpu_pool_workers_line: 34 launches logged 'CPU pool: 9 workers by default (10 physical cores, 16 logical processors; bounded by every physical core but the host's)' with 9 pool workers on logical processors 2,4,6,8,10,12,13,14,15 and the host thread on 0. Eight launches passed --pool-workers 6; only two of them (11:31:51 and 11:34:58) reached the point of logging '6 pool workers on logical processors 2,4,6,8,10,1' - five of the eight died on unknown arguments (11:13:40, 11:18:22, 11:21:07, 11:33:48, 11:34:19) and one (11:29:40) logged no worker line at all, so 2 + 5 + 1 = 8

vram_reserve_advice_in_those_warnings_mi.note: 13 warnings, one advice value each; the advice is computed from the launch's own state, so different advice in different launches is not a contradiction

engine_internal_values_observed.prompt_path_borrowed_cache_slots: between 312 and 1107 CUDA0 cache slots, value logged per session

cpu_features.note: 52 of 57 launches logged the AVX-512 line; the five that died on unknown arguments did not. 36 of those 52 also logged MAP_HUGETLB unavailable, so 16 launches logged the CPU-feature line without the huge-page line (15 of them with --vision, 1 without; both engine generations). extraction.tool: mawk 1.3.4 (this host's default awk); the program is published in this directory as extract.awk and is written with one-line conditions so it runs under mawk
extraction.program_note: extract.awk takes the install root and the home directory as -v R=… and -v H=… at run time, so the published program contains no absolute personal path. Run: printf 'kind\tlog_line\tengine_started_local\tpayload\n' > engine-diagnostics.tsv; awk -v lo=1 -v hi=13420 -v R="$INSTALL_ROOT" -v H="$HOME_DIR" -f extract.awk "$ENGINE_LOG" >> engine-diagnostics.tsv
extraction.column_semantics: engine_started_local is the timestamp of the engine launch a record belongs to; records appearing before the first captured 'engine started' line carry the literal value 'no-engine-start-seen' rather than a guessed timestamp
sanitization_applied: absolute paths under the local Strata install root replaced by <STRATA_INSTALL_ROOT>/, matched literally and only where the root begins a path and ends at a path boundary, so a different component that merely shares the prefix (…/strata-v2/…) is left alone
any remaining occurrence of the local home path replaced by <HOME>, by the same literal boundary-aware rule (zero such occurrences remained in this run)
the '[strata] <date> <time> engine started: ' prefix stripped, with the timestamp kept as its own column
no prompt text, completion text, tool output or conversation content is selected by the whitelist
the program refuses to publish if any absolute personal path survives these substitutions (exit 66), and refuses to exit successfully having selected nothing (exit 65)
extraction.continuation_lines: multi-line engine messages are published as their first line plus every following indented line, tagged kind=continuation; 108 such lines exist, three per launch for the 36 launches that logged the expert-cache parity note
extraction.reproduction_check: re-run with extract.awk at 17 233, at 18 689, at 19 664 and at 20 648 log lines (last on 2026-11-04T00:48:21Z); output byte-for-byte identical to the committed TSV every time. No re-derivation of THIS dataset is recorded at 15 693 lines, contrary to what results/README.md claimed until 2026-11-05 (conflict C13). Re-derived again from the archived copy on 2026-11-05 with the corrected program: identical

limitations: this dataset contains no per-request throughput records; throughput lives in the two request datasets
the 0.1.54-era sessions are covered here at launch and configuration level only; their request records are not published (gap G7)
the whitelist is a choice, not a complete capture: per-request counters such as route-tail-skip totals, suffix-draft totals and per-request KV-streaming hit rates are deliberately excluded here
engine diagnostics lines are the engine's own claims about itself; they are measurements of what the engine decided, not independent confirmations that the decision was correct
'sessions_with_no_logged_mtp_outcome' is an absence of a published line, not proof that MTP did not load
counts are per launch; a launch is not a measurement

the census includes 8 launches of an IQ3_S quantization whose file sizes and hashes are recorded nowhere in this repository (gap G14); the IQ3_S launches are counted in every whole-window figure above but are otherwise undocumented here
